technical_and_design_decisions: For U1, the alternative DLQ configuration will leverage existing Spring AMQP Dead Letter Queue support with an additional property to specify a custom DLQ name and headers containing exception details including stack trace.

For U2, the database change event streaming module will be implemented using Change Data Capture (CDC) with Debezium embedded or a similar library, providing connectors to publish events to brokers, Hadoop, and databases.
For U3, RabbitMQ cluster connectivity will be added via a ConnectionFactory that supports multiple hosts and automatic failover, integrated into Spring AMQP's native configuration.
For U4 and U8, dependency upgrades will follow Spring Data and Spring Boot release compatibility matrices, with careful review of breaking changes.

For U5, colocated stream deployment and leader election will use Spring Cloud Stream's container mode and integrate a leader election mechanism (e.g., using ZooKeeper or Spring Cloud Cluster) for automatic failover.
For U6 and U7, upgrading to Spring Integration milestones and the Kafka extension will involve updating imports, adapting to API changes if any, and synchronizing with the latest JMX improvements.
assumptions: All required upstream releases (Gemfire 8.1, Spring Data Gosling GA, Spring Integration milestone/GA, SI Kafka release, Spring Boot 1.2.3) are available and stable at the time of development.
The development is performed by a single experienced Spring developer who is familiar with the codebase and the technologies involved.
Effort estimates include design, implementation, unit testing, integration testing, and documentation for each activity.
No major architectural changes beyond the described features are required.
The existing test suite can be extended without complete rewrite, and CI/CD pipeline adjustments are minimal.
For U2, a suitable CDC library is already available and compatible with the project's framework version.
